testcase.name: Scenario: Cancel staged commands on two ribbon targets: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1688:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Cancel staged commands on two ribbon targets ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And the Part Tools and Part Manage custom panel lists are empty ✔ And ribbon customization is open with All Commands as the source ✔ When the user adds "2D Sketches" to Part Tools ✔ And the user selects Part Manage as the target ✔ And the user adds "3D Annotations" to Part Manage ✔ Then Part Manage is marked as having pending changes ✔ And its target list contains "3D Annotations" ✔ When the user clicks Cancel without applying the changes ✔ And the user reopens ribbon customization from Tools ✔ Then Part Tools is selected and its target list is empty ✔ And "2D Sketches" and "3D Annotations" are available in the source list ✔ When the user selects Part Manage as the target ✔ Then its target list is empty ✔ And the target selector has no pending-change marker ✔ When the user closes customization ✔ Then the customization dialog closes
